description: This file defines the 'ReminderEntity' class, which models reminder data for Orleans Cosmos DB persistence layer. It includes properties for partitioning, service, grain, and timing details, as well as static methods for ID and partition key construction.

classes.name: ReminderEntity
classes.description: Internal class representing a reminder entity with properties for storage and static methods for ID and partition key generation.

methods.name: ConstructId
methods.description: Constructs a unique reminder ID string based on the grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ConstructPartitionKey
methods.description: Constructs a partition key string using service ID and grain hash code.
